questions.question: Explain contrasting Christian and Muslim views on abortion.

points.text: Catholics believe abortion is always wrong because life begins at conception and the foetus has an absolute right to life (Jeremiah 1:5). In contrast, most Muslims permit abortion before 120 days (ensoulment) in cases of rape, risk to the mother, or serious abnormality.
